_comment: Expansion 3 part D.3: level 6 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

blade_barrier.name: Blade Barrier
blade_barrier.text: A wall of whirling blades rises from your side in a line 100 feet long (concentration, ten minutes). Whoever is in it, or walks in or ends a turn there, makes a Dexterity save or takes 6d10 force, half on a save. It is slow going.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.text: A bolt strikes a foe within 150 feet, then leaps to three more within 30 feet of it, nearest first: each makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d8 lightning, half on a save. Each higher slot sends one more bolt leaping.

circle_of_death.name: Circle of Death

material.text: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP

circle_of_death.text: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot radius up to 150 feet away: everyone in it, friend or foe, makes a Constitution save or takes 8d8 necrotic, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 2d8.

conjure_fey.name: Conjure Fey
conjure_fey.text: A Medium spirit of the Feywild appears within 60 feet (concentration, ten minutes) and strikes at once: a melee spell attack for 3d12 psychic, and the foe is frightened until your next turn. A bonus action each turn sends it to strike again. Each higher slot adds 2d12.

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.text: A green ray at a foe within 60 feet: a Dexterity save or 10d6+40 force, no half. A creature it brings to nothing crumbles to dust, and nothing brings it back. Each higher slot adds 3d6. Objects and walls of force are not in the game.

eyebite.name: Eyebite

again.name: Eyebite: another gaze
again.text: While the spell holds, an action turns your gaze on another foe within 60 feet: a Wisdom save or it falls Asleep, until it is hurt.

eyebite.text: Your eyes become an inky void (concentration, a minute). A foe within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or falls Asleep until it is hurt. An action each turn turns the gaze on another foe. Panicked and Sickened are left out.

flesh_to_stone.name: Flesh to Stone
flesh_to_stone.text: A foe within 60 feet makes a Constitution save (constructs always pass). On a failure it is restrained and saves at each turn's end: three successes free it, three failures turn it to stone (concentration, a minute). A save leaves it rooted till your next turn.

globe_of_invulnerability.name: Globe of Invulnerability
globe_of_invulnerability.text: A shimmering barrier 10 feet around you (concentration, a minute): spells of the slot's level or lower cast from outside do nothing to those in it. Fifth level and below at 6th; each higher slot keeps out one level more. It moves with you here.

harm.name: Harm
harm.text: Virulent magic at a foe within 60 feet: a Constitution save or 14d6 necrotic, half on a save. On a failure its hit point maximum falls by the damage taken (never below 1) until the fight is done.

heal.name: Heal
heal.text: Positive energy restores 70 hit points to a creature within 60 feet and ends its blindness, deafness and poison. Each higher slot adds 10 hit points.

mass_suggestion.name: Mass Suggestion
mass_suggestion.text: Honeyed words to up to twelve foes within 60 feet, nearest first: each makes a Wisdom save or lays down its arms and waits, until it is hurt. The book lets you set a task for a day; in a fight here they only stand down.

otilukes_freezing_sphere.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
otilukes_freezing_sphere.text: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot radius up to 300 feet away: everyone in it, friend or foe, makes a Constitution save or takes 10d6 cold, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d6. Freezing water and holding the globe back are left out.

ottos_irresistible_dance.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
ottos_irresistible_dance.text: A foe within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it dances (concentration, a minute): no walking, disadvantage on its attacks and Dexterity saves, advantage against it; each turn it spends its action to save again. On a save it dances in place until your next turn.

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam

again.name: Sunbeam: a new line
again.text: While the spell holds, an action sends another line of sunlight 60 feet from you: a Constitution save or 6d8 radiant and blinded, half damage on a save.

sunbeam.text: A beam of sunlight 60 feet long from your hand (concentration, a minute): all in the line make a Constitution save or take 6d8 radiant and are blinded until your next turn, half damage on a save. An action sends a new line.

true_seeing.name: True Seeing

material.text: mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

true_seeing.text: A touch gives a willing creature truesight to 120 feet for an hour: it sees the invisible and through any darkness. It consumes mushroom powder worth 25 gold.

wall_of_ice.name: Wall of Ice
wall_of_ice.text: A wall of ice rises in a block 20 feet across within 120 feet (concentration, ten minutes). Those it rises beside make a Dexterity save or take 10d6 cold, half on a save. Nothing passes it. Each higher slot adds 2d6. It cannot be broken here.

wall_of_thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wall_of_thorns.text: A wall of needle-sharp thorns, 60 feet long, rises from your side (concentration, ten minutes). Those in it as it appears save or take 7d8 piercing; later, whoever enters or ends a turn there saves or takes 7d8 slashing, half on a save. It blocks sight. Each higher slot adds 1d8 to both.
